title: beautiful  and functional
text: beautiful  and functional. I don't smoke but have friends who do. This is beautiful (doesn't look like a nasty ashtray) and is very functional. Just lift the center piece and the ashes and butts drop into the reservoir below. Form and function. I like it and so do my smoker friends.
